title: Authority boundaries
summary: WebDAV composes existing transport, storage and queue services without absorbing their authority.
invariants: HTTPS Server owns TCP, TLS and HTTP framing, including any future streaming request/response transport hooks.
WebDAV owns DAV methods, properties, locks, preconditions, sync semantics and path projection.
Storage Fabric owns StorageRef identity, namespace policy, byte source/sink contracts, verification and commit.
Queue Fabric owns durable command delivery when selected; queue completion is not Storage commit authority.
Hercules Storage adapters own AWSTAPE edge encoding; WebDAV does not invent emulator/device semantics.
